packages.summary: OpenOS home screen and app launcher.
packages.description: Updates the OpenOS home screen, app grid, folders, icon ordering and app context menu.

packages.summary: OpenOS lock screen and passcode panel.
packages.description: Updates the OpenOS lock screen, clock display and passcode interface.
Updates Control Center and its quick controls for connectivity, brightness and system actions.
Updates Settings, including connectivity, appearance, passcode, applications, storage and device information.

packages.summary: Browse and open files on the SD card.
packages.description: Updates the OpenOS file browser and file launching interface.
Updates the OpenOS clock application and its time display.
Updates the OpenOS calculator interface and calculation logic.

packages.summary: Create and edit notes on the SD card.
packages.description: Updates the OpenOS notes application, multiline editor and note browser.

packages.summary: Compile OSA source files on the device.
packages.description: Updates the optional on-device OSA compiler interface.
Updates OpenStore, including user applications, system application updates and OPK package management.

packages.summary: Simple tap counter app for OpenOS
packages.description: A tiny OSA app that counts taps. Press the button to increment, press Reset to zero it out. No permissions needed — good starter example for touch input in OSA.
